top_signals.title: Marriott Bets on Asia as Hotel and Travel Demand Grows
top_signals.summary:
Marriott International Asia Pacific excluding China President Rajeev Menon says his company is expanding across Asia-Pacific, as travel demand and hotel performance strengthen. The world’s largest hotel group sees India, Vietnam, Southeast Asia and Japan driving growth, supported by rapidly rising intra-regional travel. He speaks with Haslinda Amin on "Insight with Haslinda Amin."
 (Source: Bloomberg)
